12pub(crate) fn split_mark_to_base(graph: &mut Graph, lookup: ObjectId) {
13    super::split_subtables(graph, lookup, split_mark_to_base_subtable)
14}

16// based off of <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/f26fd69d858642d764/src/graph/markbasepos-graph.hh#L212>
17fn split_mark_to_base_subtable(graph: &mut Graph, subtable: ObjectId) -> Option<Vec<ObjectId>> {
18    // the base size for the table, not the size of the 'base glyphs subtable'
19    const BASE_SIZE: usize = 6 * u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN // six short fields in subtable
20                               + u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN // empty mark array table
21                               + u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN; // empty base array table
22    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
23    let base_coverage_id = data.offsets[1].object;
24    let base_coverage_size = graph.objects[&base_coverage_id].bytes.len();
25    debug_assert!(data.reparse::<rgpos::MarkBasePosFormat1>().is_ok());
26
27    let min_subtable_size = BASE_SIZE + base_coverage_size;
28    let class_info = get_class_info(graph, subtable);
29
30    let base_array_off = &data.offsets[3];
31    let base_array_data = &graph.objects[&base_array_off.object];
32
33    let mark_class_count: u16 = data.read_at(6).unwrap_or(0);
34    debug_assert_eq!(class_info.len(), mark_class_count as usize);
35    let base_count: u16 = base_array_data.read_at(0).unwrap_or(0);
36
37    let mut partial_coverage_size = 4;
38    let mut accumulated = min_subtable_size;
39    let mut split_points = Vec::new();
40    let mut visited = HashSet::new();
41
42    for i in 0..mark_class_count {
43        let info = &class_info[i as usize];
44        partial_coverage_size += u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN * info.marks.len();
45
46        let mut accumulated_delta =
47            // the records for the marks in this class
48            rgpos::MarkRecord::RAW_BYTE_LEN * info.marks.len()
49            // plus an offset in each base record for this class
50            + Offset16::RAW_BYTE_LEN * base_count as usize;
51        accumulated_delta += compute_subgraph_size(&info.children, graph, &mut visited);
52        accumulated += accumulated_delta;
53        let total = accumulated + partial_coverage_size;
54
55        if total > super::MAX_TABLE_SIZE {
56            log::trace!("adding split at {i}");
57            split_points.push(i as usize);
58            accumulated = min_subtable_size + accumulated_delta;
59            partial_coverage_size = 4 + u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN * info.marks.len();
60            visited.clear();
61        }
62    }
63
64    log::debug!(
65        "nothing to split, size '{}'",
66        accumulated + partial_coverage_size
67    );
68
69    if split_points.is_empty() {
70        return None;
71    }
72
73    split_points.push(mark_class_count as _);
74    let mut new_subtables = Vec::new();
75    let mut prev_split = 0;
76
77    for next_split in split_points {
78        let new_subtable = split_off_mark_pos(graph, subtable, prev_split, next_split, &class_info);
79        prev_split = next_split;
80        new_subtables.push(graph.add_object(new_subtable));
81    }
82
83    Some(new_subtables)
84}

86// based off of <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/f26fd69d858642/src/graph/markbasepos-graph.hh#L411>
87fn split_off_mark_pos(
88    graph: &mut Graph,
89    subtable: ObjectId,
90    start: usize,
91    end: usize,
92    class_info: &[Mark2BaseClassInfo],
93) -> TableData {
94    let mark_coverage_id = graph.objects[&subtable].offsets.first().unwrap().object;
95    let mark_coverage = &graph.objects[&mark_coverage_id];
96    let mark_coverage = mark_coverage.reparse::<rlayout::CoverageTable>().unwrap();
97    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
98    let base_coverage_id = data.offsets[1].object;
99    let mark_array_id = data.offsets[2].object;
100    let base_array_id = data.offsets[3].object;
101    let old_mark_array = &graph.objects[&mark_array_id];
102    let old_base_array = &graph.objects[&base_array_id];
103    let mark_class_count = (end - start) as u16;
104    let mut new_subtable = TableData::new(data.type_);
105
106    let mark_glyphs_by_cov_id: HashSet<_> = (start..end)
107        .flat_map(|class_idx| class_info[class_idx].marks.iter())
108        .copied()
109        .collect();
110    let new_mark_coverage: CoverageTable = mark_coverage
111        .iter()
112        .enumerate()
113        .filter_map(|(i, gid)| mark_glyphs_by_cov_id.contains(&i).then_some(gid))
114        .collect();
115    let new_mark_coverage = super::make_table_data(&new_mark_coverage);
116    let new_mark_array = split_off_mark_array(old_mark_array, start as u16, &mark_glyphs_by_cov_id);
117    let new_base_array = split_off_base_array(old_base_array, start, end, class_info.len());
118    let new_mark_coverage_id = graph.add_object(new_mark_coverage);
119    let new_mark_array_id = graph.add_object(new_mark_array);
120    let new_base_array_id = graph.add_object(new_base_array);
121
122    new_subtable.write(1u16); // format
123    new_subtable.add_offset(new_mark_coverage_id, 2, 0);
124    new_subtable.add_offset(base_coverage_id, 2, 0);
125    new_subtable.write(mark_class_count);
126    new_subtable.add_offset(new_mark_array_id, 2, 0);
127    new_subtable.add_offset(new_base_array_id, 2, 0);
128
129    new_subtable
130}

132// <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/f26fd69d858642d76413b8f/src/graph/markbasepos-graph.hh#L170>
133fn split_off_mark_array(
134    old_mark_array: &TableData,
135    first_class: u16,
136    mark_glyph_coverage_ids: &HashSet<usize>,
137) -> TableData {
138    let mark_array = old_mark_array.reparse::<rgpos::MarkArray>().unwrap();
139    let mark_count = mark_glyph_coverage_ids.len() as u16;
140
141    let mut new_mark_array = TableData::new(old_mark_array.type_);
142    new_mark_array.write(mark_count);
143
144    for (i, mark_record) in mark_array.mark_records().iter().enumerate() {
145        if !mark_glyph_coverage_ids.contains(&i) {
146            continue;
147        }
148        let new_class = mark_record.mark_class() - first_class;
149        let anchor_offset = old_mark_array.offsets[i].object;
150
151        new_mark_array.write(new_class);
152        new_mark_array.add_offset(anchor_offset, 2, 0);
153    }
154
155    new_mark_array
156}

158fn split_off_base_array(
159    old_base_array: &TableData,
160    start: usize,
161    end: usize,
162    old_mark_class_count: usize,
163) -> TableData {
164    let mut new_base_array = TableData::new(old_base_array.type_);
165    let base_count: u16 = old_base_array.read_at(0).unwrap_or(0);
166    new_base_array.write(base_count);
167
168    // the base array contains a (base_count x mark_count) matrix of offsets.
169    // for each base, we want to prune the marks to only include those
170    // in the range (start..end).
171
172    let base_array: rgpos::BaseArray = old_base_array
173        .reparse_with_args(&(old_mark_class_count as u16))
174        .unwrap();
175
176    let mut next_offset_idx = 0;
177    // because offsets may be null, and there is no pattern, we visit each one
178    for base_record in base_array.base_records().iter() {
179        let base_record = base_record.unwrap();
180        for (mark_class, offset) in base_record.base_anchor_offsets().iter().enumerate() {
181            let has_offset = !offset.get().is_null();
182            let in_range = (start..end).contains(&mark_class);
183
184            if in_range {
185                if has_offset {
186                    let id = old_base_array.offsets[next_offset_idx].object;
187                    new_base_array.add_offset(id, 2, 0);
188                } else {
189                    // manually write null value
190                    new_base_array.write(0u16);
191                }
192            }
193
194            if has_offset {
195                next_offset_idx += 1;
196            }
197        }
198    }
199
200    new_base_array
201}

203/// Information about a single mark class in a Mark2Base subtable
204#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
205struct Mark2BaseClassInfo {
206    // value is the order in the coverage table
207    marks: HashSet<usize>,
208    children: Vec<ObjectId>,
209}
210
211// this is not general purpose! tailored to mark2pos
212fn compute_subgraph_size(
213    objects: &[ObjectId],
214    graph: &Graph,
215    visited: &mut HashSet<ObjectId>,
216) -> usize {
217    objects
218        .iter()
219        .map(|id| {
220            if !visited.insert(*id) {
221                return 0;
222            }
223            // the size of the anchor table
224            let base_size = graph.objects[id].bytes.len();
225            // the size of any devices or variation indices.
226            let children_size = graph.objects[id]
227                .offsets
228                .iter()
229                .map(|id| {
230                    // the mark2pos subgraph is only ever two layers deep
231                    debug_assert!(graph.objects[&id.object].offsets.is_empty());
232                    if visited.insert(id.object) {
233                        graph.objects[&id.object].bytes.len()
234                    } else {
235                        0
236                    }
237                })
238                .sum::<usize>();
239            base_size + children_size
240        })
241        .sum()
242}
243
244// get info about the mark classes in a MarkToBase subtable.
245//
246// based on <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/f26fd69d858642d76/src/graph/markbasepos-graph.hh#L316>
247fn get_class_info(graph: &Graph, subtable: ObjectId) -> Vec<Mark2BaseClassInfo> {
248    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
249    let mark_class_count: u16 = data.read_at(6).unwrap_or(0);
250    let mut class_to_info = vec![Mark2BaseClassInfo::default(); mark_class_count as usize];
251    let mark_array_off = &data.offsets[2];
252    assert_eq!(mark_array_off.pos, 8);
253    let mark_array_data = &graph.objects[&mark_array_off.object];
254    let mark_array = mark_array_data.reparse::<rgpos::MarkArray>().unwrap();
255    // okay so:
256    // - there is one mark record for each mark glyph
257    // - there may be multiple mark glyphs with the same class
258    for (i, mark_record) in mark_array.mark_records().iter().enumerate() {
259        let mark_class = mark_record.mark_class();
260        // this shouldn't happen unless data is malformed? but harfbuzz includes
261        // this check, and it doesn't hurt.
262        if mark_class >= mark_class_count {
263            continue;
264        }
265        let anchor_table_id = mark_array_data.offsets[i].object;
266        class_to_info[mark_class as usize].marks.insert(i);
267        class_to_info[mark_class as usize]
268            .children
269            .push(anchor_table_id);
270    }
271
272    // - base array declares one record for each base glyph (in cov table order)
273    // - each record has an anchor for each mark glyph
274    let base_array_off = &data.offsets[3];
275    assert_eq!(base_array_off.pos, 10);
276    let base_array_data = &graph.objects[&base_array_off.object];
277
278    for offsets in base_array_data.offsets.chunks_exact(mark_class_count as _) {
279        for (i, off) in offsets.iter().enumerate() {
280            class_to_info[i].children.push(off.object)
281        }
282    }
283
284    class_to_info
285}

298        tables::{
299            gpos::{AnchorTable, BaseArray, BaseRecord, MarkArray, MarkBasePosFormat1, MarkRecord},

305    use super::*;
306
307    // too fancy, but:
308    //
309    // we want to create anchor tables for each glyph, and later check that
310    // we have the correct anchor tables after splitting.
311    //
312    // the idea here is to map u16s to i16s in a way that is easy to understand
313    // at a glance, so we do 0, 1 .. i16::MAX, -1, -2 .. i16::MIN
314    fn u16_to_i16(val: u16) -> i16 {
315        match i16::try_from(val) {
316            Ok(val) => val,
317            Err(_) => i16::MAX.saturating_sub_unsigned(val),
318        }
319    }
320
321    fn make_mark_array(
322        class_count: u16,
323        glyphs_per_class: u16,
324        // if true we add VariationIndex subtables to our anchors,
325        // which is important because it adds an extra layer to the graph
326        // and complicates packing
327        include_var_index_tables: bool,
328    ) -> MarkArray {
329        let mark_glyph_count = class_count * glyphs_per_class;
330        let records = (0..mark_glyph_count)
331            .map(|cov_idx| {
332                let mark_class = cov_idx / glyphs_per_class;
333                let val = u16_to_i16(cov_idx);
334                let anchor = if include_var_index_tables {
335                    let var_idx = VariationIndex::new(cov_idx, cov_idx);
336                    AnchorTable::format_3(val, val, Some(var_idx.into()), None)
337                } else {
338                    AnchorTable::format_1(val, val)
339                };
340                MarkRecord::new(mark_class, anchor)
341            })
342            .collect();
343        MarkArray::new(records)
344    }
345
346    fn make_base_array(
347        base_count: u16,
348        mark_class_count: u16,
349        include_var_index_tables: bool,
350    ) -> BaseArray {
351        let base_records = (0..base_count)
352            .map(|i| {
353                let mark_anchors = (0..mark_class_count)
354                    .map(|j| {
355                        // even anchors exist, odd anchors are null
356                        (j % 2 == 0).then(|| {
357                            let val = u16_to_i16(i * mark_class_count + j);
358                            if include_var_index_tables {
359                                // we want duplicate variation index tables, since it
360                                // poses different challenges when resolving offsets
361                                let var_idx = VariationIndex::new(j, j);
362                                AnchorTable::format_3(val, val, Some(var_idx.into()), None)
363                            } else {
364                                AnchorTable::format_1(val, val)
365                            }
366                        })
367                    })
368                    .collect();
369                BaseRecord::new(mark_anchors)
370            })
371            .collect();
372        BaseArray::new(base_records)
373    }
374
375    // big sanity check of splitting a real table
376    #[test]
377    fn split_mark_2_base() {
378        let _ = env_logger::builder().is_test(true).try_init();
379        const MARK_CLASS_COUNT: u16 = 100;
380        const MARKS_PER_CLASS: u16 = 4;
381        const N_BASES: u16 = 200;
382        const N_MARKS: u16 = MARK_CLASS_COUNT * MARKS_PER_CLASS;
383        const FIRST_BASE_GLYPH: u16 = 2;
384        const FIRST_MARK_GLYPH: u16 = 2000;
385
386        let mark_coverage = (FIRST_MARK_GLYPH..FIRST_MARK_GLYPH + N_MARKS)
387            .map(GlyphId16::new)
388            .collect();
389        let base_coverage = (FIRST_BASE_GLYPH..FIRST_BASE_GLYPH + N_BASES)
390            .map(GlyphId16::new)
391            .collect();
392        let mark_array = make_mark_array(MARK_CLASS_COUNT, MARKS_PER_CLASS, false);
393        let base_array = make_base_array(N_BASES, MARK_CLASS_COUNT, false);
394
395        let table = MarkBasePosFormat1::new(mark_coverage, base_coverage, mark_array, base_array);
396        let lookup = Lookup::new(LookupFlag::empty(), vec![table]);
397        let mut graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&lookup);
398        let id = graph.root;
399        assert!(graph.objects[&id].type_.is_promotable());
400        split_mark_to_base(&mut graph, id);
401        graph.remove_orphans();
402        assert!(graph.basic_sort());
403
404        let dumped = graph.serialize();
405        let read_back =
406            rlayout::Lookup::<rgpos::MarkBasePosFormat1>::read(dumped.as_slice().into()).unwrap();
407
408        // quick sanity check: do the coverage tables match?
409        let mark_cov: CoverageTable = read_back
410            .subtables()
411            .iter()
412            .flat_map(|sub| {
413                sub.ok()
414                    .and_then(|sub| sub.mark_coverage().ok().map(|cov| cov.iter()))
415            })
416            .flatten()
417            .collect();
418        assert_eq!(&mark_cov, lookup.subtables[0].mark_coverage.as_ref());
419        let base_cov: CoverageTable = read_back
420            .subtables()
421            .iter()
422            .flat_map(|sub| {
423                sub.ok()
424                    .and_then(|sub| sub.base_coverage().ok().map(|cov| cov.iter()))
425            })
426            .flatten()
427            .collect();
428        assert_eq!(&base_cov, lookup.subtables[0].base_coverage.as_ref());
429
430        // this is a closure for comparing the pre-and-post split values
431        let compare_old_and_new = |base_gid, mark_gid| {
432            // now let's manually check one of the records.
433            let base_gid = GlyphId16::new(base_gid);
434            let mark_gid = GlyphId16::new(mark_gid);
435
436            // find the values in the original table:
437            let old_subtable = &lookup.subtables[0];
438
439            let base_cov_idx = base_gid.to_u16() - FIRST_BASE_GLYPH;
440            let mark_cov_idx = mark_gid.to_u16() - FIRST_MARK_GLYPH;
441
442            // first find the original values
443            let orig_mark_record = &old_subtable.mark_array.mark_records[mark_cov_idx as usize];
444            let orig_base_anchor = &old_subtable.base_array.base_records[base_cov_idx as usize]
445                .base_anchors[orig_mark_record.mark_class as usize];
446
447            // then find the post-split subtable with this mark glyph
448            let new_subtable = read_back
449                .subtables()
450                .iter()
451                .find_map(|sub| {
452                    let sub = sub.unwrap();
453                    sub.mark_coverage()
454                        .unwrap()
455                        .get(mark_gid)
456                        .is_some()
457                        .then_some(sub)
458                })
459                .unwrap();
460            let new_mark_idx = new_subtable.mark_coverage().unwrap().get(mark_gid).unwrap();
461            let new_base_idx = new_subtable.base_coverage().unwrap().get(base_gid).unwrap();
462            let new_mark_array = new_subtable.mark_array().unwrap();
463            let new_mark_record = &new_mark_array.mark_records()[new_mark_idx as usize];
464            let new_mark_anchor = new_mark_record
465                .mark_anchor(new_mark_array.offset_data())
466                .unwrap();
467            let new_base_array = new_subtable.base_array().unwrap();
468            let new_base_anchor = new_base_array
469                .base_records()
470                .get(new_base_idx as usize)
471                .unwrap()
472                .base_anchors(new_base_array.offset_data())
473                .get(new_mark_record.mark_class() as usize)
474                .transpose()
475                .unwrap();
476
477            fn get_f1_anchor_x_coords(old: &AnchorTable, new: &rgpos::AnchorTable) -> (i16, i16) {
478                match (old, new) {
479                    (AnchorTable::Format1(old), rgpos::AnchorTable::Format1(new)) => {
480                        (old.x_coordinate, new.x_coordinate())
481                    }
482                    _ => panic!("only format 1 here"),
483                }
484            }
485
486            let (old_mark_x, new_mark_x) =
487                get_f1_anchor_x_coords(orig_mark_record.mark_anchor.as_ref(), &new_mark_anchor);
488            assert_eq!(old_mark_x, new_mark_x);
489            let (old_base_x, new_base_x) = orig_base_anchor
490                .as_ref()
491                .zip(new_base_anchor.as_ref())
492                .map(|(old, new)| get_f1_anchor_x_coords(old, new))
493                .unwrap_or_default();
494            assert_eq!(old_base_x, new_base_x);
495        };
496
497        // the first two, the last two, and an even/odd pair in the middle
498        for base in [2, 3, 150, 151, 200, 201] {
499            for mark in [2000, 2001, 2222, 2211, 2398, 2399] {
500                compare_old_and_new(base, mark);
501            }
502        }
503    }

505    #[test]
506    fn full_split_including_variation_index_tables() {
507        let _ = env_logger::builder().is_test(true).try_init();
508
509        const MARK_CLASS_COUNT: u16 = 120;
510        const MARKS_PER_CLASS: u16 = 4;
511        const N_BASES: u16 = 500;
512        const N_MARKS: u16 = MARK_CLASS_COUNT * MARKS_PER_CLASS;
513        const FIRST_BASE_GLYPH: u16 = 2;
514        const FIRST_MARK_GLYPH: u16 = 2000;
515
516        let mark_coverage = (FIRST_MARK_GLYPH..FIRST_MARK_GLYPH + N_MARKS)
517            .map(GlyphId16::new)
518            .collect();
519        let base_coverage = (FIRST_BASE_GLYPH..FIRST_BASE_GLYPH + N_BASES)
520            .map(GlyphId16::new)
521            .collect();
522        let mark_array = make_mark_array(MARK_CLASS_COUNT, MARKS_PER_CLASS, true);
523        let base_array = make_base_array(N_BASES, MARK_CLASS_COUNT, true);
524
525        let table = MarkBasePosFormat1::new(mark_coverage, base_coverage, mark_array, base_array);
526        let lookup = Lookup::new(LookupFlag::empty(), vec![table]);
527        let lookup_list = LookupList::new(vec![lookup]);
528        let bytes = crate::dump_table(&lookup_list).unwrap();
529        let read_back = rgpos::PositionLookupList::read(bytes.as_slice().into()).unwrap();
530        assert_eq!(read_back.lookup_count(), 1);
531        let lookup = read_back.lookups().get(0).unwrap();
532
533        let subtables: Vec<_> = match lookup.subtables().unwrap() {
534            PositionSubtables::MarkToBase(subs) => subs.iter().map(|sub| sub.unwrap()).collect(),
535            _ => panic!("wrong lookup type"),
536        };
537
538        assert_eq!(subtables.len(), 7);
539
540        // now we want to check to see that one of our variation index tables is correct.
541        // in the markarray, each mark has a varidx table, with both values equal
542        // to that mark's original coverage index.
543
544        let mark_cov_idx_to_test = 72;
545        let orig_anchor = &lookup_list.lookups[0].subtables[0].mark_array.mark_records
546            [mark_cov_idx_to_test]
547            .mark_anchor;
548        // sanity check that our logic makes sense
549        match orig_anchor.as_ref() {
550            AnchorTable::Format3(anchor) => match anchor.x_device.as_ref() {
551                Some(DeviceOrVariationIndex::VariationIndex(varidx))
552                    if varidx.delta_set_outer_index == mark_cov_idx_to_test as u16 => {}
553                _ => panic!("bad assumptions"),
554            },
555            _ => panic!("very bad assumptions"),
556        };
557
558        let gid = GlyphId16::new(FIRST_MARK_GLYPH + mark_cov_idx_to_test as u16);
559        let subtable = subtables
560            .iter()
561            .find(|sub| sub.mark_coverage().unwrap().get(gid).is_some())
562            .expect("should exist in some subtable");
563        let new_cov_idx = subtable.mark_coverage().unwrap().get(gid).unwrap();
564        let mark_array = subtable.mark_array().unwrap();
565        let mark_record = &mark_array.mark_records()[new_cov_idx as usize];
566        let mark_anchor = mark_record.mark_anchor(mark_array.offset_data()).unwrap();
567        let rgpos::AnchorTable::Format3(mark_anchor) = mark_anchor else {
568            panic!("wrong format")
569        };
570
571        // moment of truth: did we preserve the correct var index table in
572        // this mark's anchor?
573        assert!(
574            matches!(mark_anchor.x_device().transpose().unwrap(), Some(rgpos::DeviceOrVariationIndex::VariationIndex(varidx)) if varidx.delta_set_outer_index() == mark_cov_idx_to_test as u16)
575        );
576    }

578    #[test]
579    fn test_my_test_helper() {
580        assert_eq!(u16_to_i16(1), 1);
581        assert_eq!(u16_to_i16(32767), 32767);
582        assert_eq!(u16_to_i16(32768), -1);
583        assert_eq!(u16_to_i16(u16::MAX), i16::MIN);
584    }

586    #[test]
587    fn split_mark_array() {
588        const N_GLYPHS: u16 = 900;
589        const N_CLASSES: u16 = 75;
590        const GLYPHS_PER_CLASS: u16 = N_GLYPHS / N_CLASSES;
591        const SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE: Range<u16> = 20..25;
592
593        let mark_array = make_mark_array(N_CLASSES, GLYPHS_PER_CLASS, false);
594
595        let graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&mark_array);
596        let data = &graph.objects[&graph.root];
597        // now let's imagine we're splitting off classes 20..25
598        let mark_glyph_coverage_ids = mark_array
599            .mark_records
600            .iter()
601            .enumerate()
602            .filter_map(|(i, rec)| SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.contains(&rec.mark_class).then_some(i))
603            .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
604
605        assert_eq!(
606            mark_glyph_coverage_ids.len(),
607            SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.len() * GLYPHS_PER_CLASS as usize
608        );
609
610        let result = split_off_mark_array(data, SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.start, &mark_glyph_coverage_ids);
611        assert_eq!(
612            result.offsets.len(),
613            GLYPHS_PER_CLASS as usize * SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.len()
614        );
615
616        let reparsed = result.reparse::<rgpos::MarkArray>().unwrap();
617        // ensure classes are correct
618        for (i, rec) in reparsed.mark_records().iter().enumerate() {
619            let exp_class = i as u16 / GLYPHS_PER_CLASS;
620            assert_eq!(rec.mark_class(), exp_class);
621        }
622
623        // ensure anchors are right
624        for (i, offset) in result.offsets.iter().enumerate() {
625            let gid_delta = SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.start * GLYPHS_PER_CLASS;
626            let gid = i as u16 + gid_delta;
627            let anchor_val = u16_to_i16(gid);
628            let anchor_table = &graph.objects[&offset.object];
629            let anchor_table = anchor_table.reparse::<rgpos::AnchorFormat1>().unwrap();
630            assert_eq!(anchor_table.x_coordinate(), anchor_val);
631        }
632    }
633
634    #[test]
635    fn split_base_array() {
636        const N_CLASSES: u16 = 20;
637        const N_BASES: u16 = 10;
638        const SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE: Range<u16> = 15..20;
639
640        let base_array = make_base_array(N_BASES, N_CLASSES, false);
641        let graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&base_array);
642        let data = &graph.objects[&graph.root];
643
644        let result = split_off_base_array(
645            data,
646            SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.start as _,
647            SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.end as _,
648            N_CLASSES as _,
649        );
650
651        assert_eq!(result.read_at::<u16>(0).unwrap(), N_BASES);
652        let mut idx = 0;
653        for base in 0..N_BASES {
654            for mark_class in 0..SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.len() as u16 {
655                let original_mark_class = mark_class + SPLIT_CLASS_RANGE.start;
656                if original_mark_class % 2 == 0 {
657                    // anchor table is non-null
658                    let anchor_id = result.offsets[idx].object;
659                    let anchor = &graph.objects[&anchor_id];
660                    let anchor = anchor.reparse::<rgpos::AnchorFormat1>().unwrap();
661
662                    let exp_val = u16_to_i16((base * N_CLASSES) + original_mark_class);
663                    assert_eq!(
664                        anchor.x_coordinate(),
665                        exp_val,
666                        "base {base} mark {mark_class} {anchor_id:?}"
667                    );
668                    idx += 1;
669                }
670            }
671        }
672    }
